# `DelegatedHeaderProviderInterface`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\OpenApi\DelegatedHeaderProviderInterface`

**Interface** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/OpenApi/DelegatedHeaderProviderInterface.php)

Exchanges an application identity for upstream headers on every bridged
operation call. Implementations must not forward the inbound MCP
Authorization/shared-secret header verbatim.

## Methods

### headers()

```php
headers(
    string $operationId,
    string $method,
    string $path,
    OpenApi\ExecutionIdentity $identity,
): array
```
